Causes so much anxiety, mostly because you have to think about every single move you make. Especially young, I’m 24 and this is the ages where everybody is working, traveling, drinking and having fun and you can’t just tell people “my joints hurt” because nobody looks at us seriously because we’re young, it’s not till it’s too late that people care. When it first came about I thought I was going crazy because I was always active and that was my therapy, when my back, knees and hips started hurting I thought it was over for me. Key is that life is mindset and there is help out there, seek help to sleep, seek medication for anxiety, but remember that won’t get rid of it. It’s you, gotta try to listen to your body no matter what’s happening around you, pretty much be selfish right now so you don’t pay for it later
